skill.essence_ascendance.running_momentu: Continuous grounded sprinting builds up to +%s%% movement speed over %s seconds.
Stopping drains a full meter over %s seconds. Sharp turns of %s degrees also drain momentum.
Sprint jumps carry earned momentum without building it. Swimming, climbing, flight, riding, and teleports clear it.
At %s%% momentum, grounded sprinting automatically steps over short obstacles up to %s blocks high.
Requires normal collision clearance. Sneaking disables the vault; higher step-height bonuses are preserved.
skill.essence_ascendance.rush.descriptio: An attributed kill fills Running Momentum and prevents its decay for %s seconds.
Further kills refresh the timer instead of stacking. No additional speed bonus; movement-mode changes and teleports still reset momentum.

Repeated hits of the same damage type become progressively less effective; taking a different type begins a new adaptation.
skill.essence_ascendance.adrenaline.desc: Losing more than the generated share of your pre-hit maximum HP in one hit grants a brief movement, ATK-speed and knockback-resistance boost.
skill.essence_ascendance.animal_gift.des: Well-fed adult animals near the player periodically provide their normal renewable products without being harmed.
skill.essence_ascendance.aquatic_body.de: Restores full underwater mining efficiency and clear vision. Swimming speed remains controlled by Swim Speed bonuses and equipment.
skill.essence_ascendance.armor_crack.des: While Frenzy is active, repeated hits against the same enemy progressively reduce its defenses.
skill.essence_ascendance.bonded_companio: Eligible bonded creatures deal more damage, are faster, and have more health and safely catch up by teleporting after falling far behind.
Standing still while facing incoming threats builds damage resistance and knockback immunity; moving or turning drains it.
skill.essence_ascendance.chain_strike.de: A charged lightning attack arcs to additional nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.
skill.essence_ascendance.charged_jump.de: Hold Jump while grounded to store power, then release for a large controllable leap.
skill.essence_ascendance.combustion.desc: Enemies killed while burning explode, ignite nearby enemies, and can begin chain reactions without damaging terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.containment_fie: While active, nearby explosions damage creatures normally but cannot break blocks, ignite terrain, affect the player, or destroy dropped items.
Reflected damage also strikes nearby hostile creatures for a reduced amount.
Reduce incoming health DMG by a generated percentage. The damage-taken fraction also sets the temporary max-HP cost per prevented DMG. Lost capacity returns empty after combat.
skill.essence_ascendance.death_rush.desc: Below half health, kills grant stacking attack and cast speed; kills near death refresh the entire rush stack.
skill.essence_ascendance.deep_ward.descr: Absorption earned from Soul Ward persists throughout combat and can exceed its normal cap, then decays after combat.
skill.essence_ascendance.desperation.des: Damage rises smoothly as the player's health falls.
skill.essence_ascendance.double_jump.des: Tap Jump once while airborne for a second jump with full directional control.
skill.essence_ascendance.metabolic_mendi: Eating converts nutrition and saturation into immediate durability repair, prioritizing equipped gear and then carried items. Feast Reflex can automatically eat for maintenance.
Each point of nutrition and saturation in a meal repairs %s%% of an item’s maximum durability. Repairs equipped gear first, then the hotbar and inventory.
skill.essence_ascendance.enchanting_insi: Enchanting tables reveal the full result before commitment and preserve the current offers until the inserted item changes.
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_bloom.d: Creature kills can bloom into bonus Essence and experience instead of improving ordinary drops.
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_wings.d: Holding Jump after the jump's apex deploys an equipment-free Elytra-style glide with better horizontal momentum retention than a standard Elytra.
skill.essence_ascendance.evasive_current: Continuous intentional movement builds dodge chance; stopping or taking a hit drains the accumulated evasion.
skill.essence_ascendance.explosive_paylo: Ranged and magical projectiles explode on damaging creature impacts, harming nearby eligible creatures without destroying terrain or starting fires. Continuing shots have a limited payload budget.
Hold Jump while airborne for jetpack thrust that accelerates from your current velocity. Use movement controls to steer laterally while thrusting. Releasing Jump immediately ends thrust and you fall normally; stamina recharges while grounded.
skill.essence_ascendance.feast_reflex.de: Consumes food and drinks much faster. Automatically eats safe hotbar food when needed, including successive meals when injured and hungry.
Prefers the most nutritious safe hotbar food. Never interrupts item use; Metabolic Mending can make damaged equipment a valid reason to eat even at full hunger.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishers_call.de: Consecutive successful catches build a shoal streak that briefly accelerates bites and can produce a second catch; a miss resets it.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishing_instinc: Fish bite sooner, the reel window is wider, and successful catches have improved treasure quality.
skill.essence_ascendance.frenzy.descript: Consecutive successful attacks build attack speed and damage; pausing or missing breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.friendly_fire_w: The player's melee, projectile, and ability attacks cannot harm allied players or tamed creatures.
skill.essence_ascendance.frostbite.descr: Repeated hits build Chill, progressively slowing and eventually freezing the enemy.
skill.essence_ascendance.guard_amplifier: Successful blocks temporarily strengthen damage reflection; a perfect block immediately reaches maximum strength and refreshes it.
skill.essence_ascendance.guarded_advance: Guarding no longer prevents sprinting, jumping, or stepping over short obstacles, and causes much less movement slowdown.
skill.essence_ascendance.herdkeeper.desc: Nearby passive livestock gather around the player and become ready to breed sooner.
skill.essence_ascendance.homing_projecti: Ranged and magical projectiles curve toward targets close to the player's aim line.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunger_ward.des: Redirects part of incoming health damage into saturation and hunger. The rest reaches health; depleted food cannot absorb damage.
Threats revealed by Threat Sense remain tracked and display compact health and armor readouts.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunters_study.d: Repeatedly killing a creature improves the quality/quantity of its ordinary drops.
Reduction in fall damage also provides reduction in all movement based damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.industrious_pre: While active, nearby furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, brewing stands, and similar work blocks process faster.
skill.essence_ascendance.inner_sustenanc: Hunger slowly restores outside combat; at full saturation, passive hunger drain stops, sleep becomes optional, and phantoms ignore the player.
Taking or dealing hostile damage pauses hunger recovery. Full hunger and saturation protect against passive drain; deliberate hunger costs still apply. You may still use a bed.
skill.essence_ascendance.interceptor.des: Ready ordinary melee attacks destroy supported hostile projectiles intersected by the forward weapon swing.
skill.essence_ascendance.kindling.descri: Repeated hits build Heat; full Heat ignites the enemy and increases damage taken while burning.
skill.essence_ascendance.lavaborn.descri: Extends swimming and clear vision to lava. Immersion causes no contact damage, and lava cannot set you on fire; unrelated fire remains dangerous outside lava.
skill.essence_ascendance.life_steal.desc: Direct weapon damage restores health, with consecutive hits on the same target increasing the healing until the attack chain breaks.
Only confirmed direct weapon hits heal. Changing targets, a missed melee attack, or waiting too long breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.metabolic_conve: Excess healing replenishes hunger and saturation, while food eaten at full hunger restores health.
skill.essence_ascendance.mining_momentum: Uninterrupted mining, especially through the same material, steadily builds mining speed until the rhythm breaks.
While sprinting with momentum, the player automatically vaults short ledges, fences, and similar obstacles without breaking stride.
skill.essence_ascendance.natures_boon.de: Mined stone, netherrack, end stone, or an equivalent dimension-native material can occasionally drop an ore from that dimension.
skill.essence_ascendance.ore_sight.descr: While holding a pickaxe, nearby natural ore is outlined and the most valuable deposit is emphasized.
skill.essence_ascendance.pain_purge.desc: Healing also restores unpaid delayed damage, including while current health is full.
skill.essence_ascendance.piercing_projec: Ranged and magical projectiles pierce shields at reduced damage and pass through several enemies, losing damage after each penetration.
skill.essence_ascendance.pocket_nets.des: Rarely grants fishing drops while swimming.
skill.essence_ascendance.alchemical_ampl: Beneficial potion effects last longer, while instantaneous beneficial potions become stronger.
skill.essence_ascendance.potion_relay.de: Beneficial potion effects applied to the player are shared at reduced duration with nearby allied players and tamed creatures.
skill.essence_ascendance.projectile_drag: Supported hostile projectiles enter a viscous field, visibly slowing all movement including their fall without stopping. The strongest nearby field applies; shots recover when they leave.
skill.essence_ascendance.pure_state.desc: The player cannot receive harmful status effects, sacrificing the ability to reflect them with Status Mirror.
Hits that are completely prevented can still trigger damage reflection, and attempted knockback is echoed back toward its source.
skill.essence_ascendance.restful_mending: Damageable equipment slowly repairs after going unused for a short time; using it again pauses its repair.
After %ss unused, one damaged item at a time repairs %s%% of its maximum durability per second.
skill.essence_ascendance.ricochet.descri: Ranged and magical projectiles rebound from their first victim toward another nearby enemy.
skill.essence_ascendance.riposte.descrip: After any perfectly timed block, the next melee attack is uninterruptible and gains bonus reach and damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.rising_recovery: Natural regeneration accelerates continuously as health falls, becoming strongest below half health.
Nexus health regeneration and eligible native food regeneration gain the same missing-health multiplier. External healing is unaffected.
skill.essence_ascendance.rooting_payload: Damaging ranged and magical projectile impacts briefly bind the struck enemy, stopping movement and jumps while allowing attacks, turning, and falling. Refreshes and continuing-shot triggers are bounded.
skill.essence_ascendance.running_momentu: Continuous sprinting gradually builds speed; stopping or turning sharply bleeds the bonus away.
skill.essence_ascendance.rush.descriptio: A kill immediately fills Running Momentum and briefly prevents it from decaying.
skill.essence_ascendance.salvagers_craft: Using a grindstone on unwanted equipment recovers a small portion of its base materials and stored enchantment experience.
skill.essence_ascendance.sanctuary.descr: While active, extends the natural hostile-spawn exclusion around the player and pacifies existing hostiles after you stop fighting back.
skill.essence_ascendance.second_wind.des: Lethal damage instead leaves the player at one health, clears queued delayed damage and harmful effects, and grants brief regeneration and strength.
Lethal damage leaves you at 1 health, clears queued delayed damage and harmful effects, then restores %s%% maximum health over %s seconds and grants +%s%% outgoing attack damage.
Second Wind and Spirit Walk share a %s second death-defiance cooldown. Damage that bypasses invulnerability is never intercepted.
skill.essence_ascendance.shatter.descrip: Killing a frozen enemy consumes its freeze and sprays damaging ice shards into nearby enemies.
skill.essence_ascendance.shattering_ward: When damage breaks the final Soul Ward heart, release a pulse that knocks nearby enemies away and begins rapid regeneration.
skill.essence_ascendance.shield_ram.desc: Sprinting into a creature while guarding staggers it and drives it out of the player's path.
skill.essence_ascendance.soul_ward.descr: Kills add ward hearts based on the victim's vitality; kills made at the ward cap refresh its duration.
skill.essence_ascendance.spirit_walk.des: Lethal damage instead makes the player intangible and harmless for several seconds, allowing normal movement before reforming safely at low health.
Lethal damage leaves you at 1 health and makes ordinary incoming damage unable to harm you for %s seconds; your player-attributed damage is suppressed during the walk.
Move normally, then reform to at least %s%% maximum health. Second Wind and Spirit Walk share a %s second cooldown; damage that bypasses invulnerability is never intercepted.
Incoming damage is queued and paid evenly over the next ten seconds instead of immediately; delayed ticks cannot be queued again.
skill.essence_ascendance.static_charge.d: Sprinting, falling, flying, or gliding stores charge that the next fully charged attack releases as lightning damage.
skill.essence_ascendance.status_mirror.d: The first harmful status effect received is immediately removed and copied to its source, followed by a cooldown.
skill.essence_ascendance.stored_force.de: Successful blocks store part of the prevented force; the player's next attack expends it for bonus damage and knockback.
skill.essence_ascendance.masterwork_temp: Temper fully repaired equipment at an anvil with compatible construction or repair materials, gaining Overdurability and a temporary role-appropriate performance bonus.
Each standard material unit adds %s%% maximum durability as Overdurability, up to %s%%.
While Overdurability remains, its item-appropriate performance bonus scales up to %s%% and falls with the remaining buffer.
The item must be fully repaired first. Ascendance equipment uses Latent nuggets, ingots, or blocks; normal repair remains in the Infuser.
Villager first-item costs receive up to a %s%% patron discount, and exhausted trades within %s blocks recover every %s seconds.
The discount stacks after normal reputation and Hero of the Village pricing; restored trades still update their normal demand.
skill.essence_ascendance.bonded_companio: Owned bonded creatures gain +%s%% attack damage, movement speed, and maximum health while loaded with you.
When farther than %s blocks behind, eligible companions attempt a safe catch-up teleport; ordered-to-sit tames stay put.
skill.essence_ascendance.alchemical_ampl: Timed beneficial effects from potions you drink, splash, or linger in gain up to +%s%% duration after normal application scaling, with diminishing returns around %s seconds.
Instant beneficial potion effects instead gain +%s%% potency; harmful effects, tipped arrows, food, beacons, commands, and other non-potion sources are unchanged.
skill.essence_ascendance.potion_relay.de: New timed beneficial potion effects are shared within %s blocks for %s%% duration with up to %s nearby allies.
Shares with allied players and owned or allied creatures. Shared effects cannot spread again.
skill.essence_ascendance.sanctuary.descr: Prevents natural monster spawns within %s blocks. Monsters targeting you disengage after %s seconds without you attacking hostile creatures.
Monsters leave you alone inside the field until you attack again. Automatic reflected damage does not break the peace. Spawners and summoned creatures are unaffected.
skill.essence_ascendance.industrious_pre: Nearby work blocks within %s blocks process at %s× speed.
Affects furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, brewing stands, campfires and other supported work blocks.
skill.essence_ascendance.containment_fie: Explosions centered within %s blocks are contained: terrain and dropped items are preserved and field owners are protected.
Other creatures still receive normal explosion damage and knockback.
skill.essence_ascendance.friendly_fire_w: Your melee attacks, projectiles and abilities cannot harm allied players or owned or allied tamed creatures.
skill.essence_ascendance.enchanting_insi: Enchanting tables reveal every enchantment in the hovered offer before commitment and keep offers stable while the inserted item is unchanged.
Offers stay the same while the inserted item is unchanged.
skill.essence_ascendance.terrain_freedom: Ignores slowing, sinking, freezing, and contact damage from cobwebs, powder snow, berry bushes, cactus, honey, soul sand, and similar terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.threat_sense.de: Reveals creatures actively targeting the player, traces dangerous projectile flight, and displays the danger area of primed explosions.
skill.essence_ascendance.tool_instinct.d: Block breaking automatically uses the correct carried Ascendance tool, and higher-tier tools gain extra speed against lower-tier materials.
skill.essence_ascendance.torchbearer.des: While mining, a torch is automatically placed from the hotbar when hostile-spawn darkness reaches your feet.
skill.essence_ascendance.trajectory_thef: Interceptor bats a projectile once toward an eligible aimed enemy, with aim assistance around the projectile, or back to its source. It relaunches at full speed with a homing correction; with no target it is destroyed.
Nearby unopened natural loot containers glow faintly through ordinary terrain.
skill.essence_ascendance.untethered_flig: Flight stamina begins recharging in the air and no longer forces a landing, turning Fatigue Flight into sustained creative-style flight.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_boost.de: Tap Jump during an Essence Wings glide for a rechargeable firework-class burst along your look direction without consuming fireworks. Works with any jump style, including ordinary jumps.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_jump.des: The extra jump becomes a stronger launch along the look direction: upward to climb, forward to accelerate, or downward to brake a fall.
Walking never tramples farmland or fragile eggs and periodically advances the growth of nearby crops.
Villagers offer better prices and nearby villagers regain exhausted trades sooner.
skill.essence_ascendance.water_walking.d: Sprint across liquid surfaces without losing speed; hold Sneak to break through the surface and swim normally.
skill.essence_ascendance.waylight.descri: A personal ethereal wisp provides clear night vision, negates Blindness and Darkness, and seeks nearby blocks where ordinary hostile mobs can naturally spawn.

attunement.essence_ascendance.method.dea: Deal real damage to enemies. Stronger enemies contribute more; repeated legitimate fights still count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.def: Defeat enemies through player-attributed attacks. Player-operated mob farms are valid.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.tak: Survive real incoming damage. Damage attributed directly to yourself does not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.pre: Prevent real incoming damage with shields, armor, resistance or other supported defenses.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.ref: Reflect damage that actually reaches an eligible attacker.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.hea: Recover actual missing health after eligible damage. Healing self-inflicted damage does not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.res: Restore hunger or saturation that was actually missing.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.con: Use hunger or saturation through exertion such as running, swimming, fighting or harvesting.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.res: Reduce a real harmful effect or supported fire, poison or wither impact.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.run: Cover distance while sprinting under your own control. New regions improve efficiency; repeated circuits remain a slower route.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.swi: Cover distance while actively swimming. Riding, idle drift and teleports do not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.fly: Cover distance while gliding or using supported survival flight. Creative flight and teleports do not count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.exp: Discover a biome for the first time in this chapter. Discoveries reset after Ascension; exploration is optional.
Reach a dimension for the first time in this chapter. Discoveries reset after Ascension; movement can complete the seal on its own.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.gat: Harvest eligible mining, chopping and digging outputs. Installed value and yield rules apply.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.har: Harvest mature crops yourself. Crop farms and legitimate extra yields count.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.cat: Reel in an actual player-attributed catch with eligible value.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.gai: Earn actual experience through eligible gameplay.
attunement.essence_ascendance.method.enc: Complete an enchantment. Previewing an offer produces no progress.

skill.essence_ascendance.frenzy.descript: Successive melee hits grant +%s%% attack damage and +%s%% attack speed per stack, up to %s stacks.
A missed melee attack or %s seconds without a melee hit breaks the chain. Attack speed also speeds up bow draw and casting.
skill.essence_ascendance.armor_crack.des: While Frenzy is active, successive melee hits remove %s armor and %s armor toughness per stack, up to %s stacks.
Changing targets, losing Frenzy, or waiting %s seconds clears the reduction.
skill.essence_ascendance.desperation.des: Gain up to +%s%% damage as health falls; the bonus scales with your missing-health fraction.
skill.essence_ascendance.death_rush.desc: Kills below %s%% health grant +%s%% melee attack, +%s%% bow draw and +%s%% caster speed per stack.
Up to %s stacks, each lasting %s seconds. Kills at or below %s%% health refresh all stacks.
skill.essence_ascendance.kindling.descri: Hits add %s Heat; at %s Heat, ignite for %s seconds and amplify your direct hit damage by %s%% while burning.
Burning deals %s%% of the latest confirmed hit per second. Unfinished Heat expires after %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.combustion.desc: Burning kills explode for %s damage within %s blocks, hitting up to %s nearby targets without breaking terrain.
Chain reactions retain %s%% damage per generation, up to %s generations and %s total targets; ignitions last %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.frostbite.descr: Hits add %s Chill toward %s; each stack slows by %s%%, capped at %s%%.
Full Chill freezes for %s seconds at %s%% slow. Unfinished Chill expires after %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.shatter.descrip: Frozen kills release shards for %s damage to up to %s other targets within %s blocks.
skill.essence_ascendance.static_charge.d: Movement fills %s charge; the next fully charged attack spends a full charge for +%s lightning damage.
Charge gained: sprinting %s/s, jumping %s, falling %s/s, flying %s/s and gliding %s/s. After %s seconds idle, incomplete charge drains at %s/s. Full charge is retained.
skill.essence_ascendance.chain_strike.de: Charged lightning jumps to up to %s additional enemies within %s blocks per jump, retaining %s%% damage each jump.
skill.essence_ascendance.homing_projecti: Arrows seek targets within %s blocks and a %s° cone, turning up to %s° per second.
Magic shots seek targets within %s blocks and a %s° cone, turning up to %s° per second.
skill.essence_ascendance.ricochet.descri: Ranged and caster shots rebound up to %s times toward enemies within %s blocks, retaining %s%% damage per rebound.
skill.essence_ascendance.piercing_projec: Ranged and caster shots continue through up to %s extra targets, retaining %s%% damage after each penetration.
Supported shield bypass deals %s%% damage. Each target is hit only once per shot.
skill.essence_ascendance.explosive_paylo: Projectile impacts explode within %s blocks for %s%% of confirmed hit damage; up to %s nearby targets and %s payload triggers per shot.
Does not damage terrain or start fires. Secondary explosions cannot trigger more payloads.
skill.essence_ascendance.rooting_payload: Projectile impacts root enemies for %s seconds, with a %s-second refresh cap and %s payload triggers per shot.
Stops movement and jumps, not attacks, turning or falling. After release, recovery immunity lasts %s seconds.
skill.essence_ascendance.projectile_drag: Slow supported hostile projectiles inside %s blocks, reaching %s%% of their speed within %s blocks.
The strongest field applies; projectiles regain speed outside it. Slows falling motion too.
skill.essence_ascendance.interceptor.des: Melee swings at %s%% readiness intercept up to %s supported hostile projectiles within %s blocks.
Swing sweep: %s-block radius and %s° half-angle. Mining is not an intercept swing.
skill.essence_ascendance.trajectory_thef: Intercepted shots relaunch at %s× speed, seeking a target within %s blocks and a %s° aim cone.
Stolen shots turn up to %s° per second and can be redirected %s times. If no aimed target is found, they return to the attacker or break.
skill.essence_ascendance.guarded_advance: Remove %s%% of guarding slowdown and allow a step height of %s blocks while using a functional shield.
skill.essence_ascendance.shield_ram.desc: Sprinting into a creature while guarding staggers it for %s seconds and adds %s knockback.
Requires forward speed of %s blocks per second. Staggered targets move at %s%% speed. Hit up to %s creatures, with %s seconds before hitting the same one again.
Fully prevented hits can reflect using %s%% of their prevented damage as the reflection base.
Echo attempted knockback at %s× strength, capped at %s. Uses your existing reflection stats.
skill.essence_ascendance.stored_force.de: Blocks store %s%% of prevented damage, up to %s force for %s seconds.
The next ready attack spends the force for %s damage and %s knockback per stored point.
skill.essence_ascendance.guard_amplifier: Blocks add +%s%% reflected damage, up to +%s%%, for %s seconds.
Blocking within %s seconds of raising the shield instantly grants the maximum bonus.
Reflections also deal %s%% of reflected damage to up to %s nearby hostile creatures within %s blocks.
skill.essence_ascendance.riposte.descrip: A perfect block arms your next melee attack for %s seconds: +%s%% damage and +%s blocks reach.
Perfect-block window: %s seconds after raising the shield. The committed strike gains %s seconds of displacement protection.
skill.essence_ascendance.evasive_current: Intentional movement builds up to %s%% dodge over %s seconds; stopping drains it over %s seconds.
A successful dodge spends %s%% of the meter; a taken hit spends %s%%.
Standing still and facing a hostile threat builds up to %s%% damage resistance over %s seconds; moving or turning drains it over %s seconds.
Threats must be within %s blocks and the %s° facing angle. Knockback immunity starts at %s%% meter.
Repeated hits of one damage type grant %s%% resistance per qualifying stack after %s hits, up to %s total recorded hits.
Maximum resistance: %s%%. A different damage type or %s seconds without that type resets adaptation.
skill.essence_ascendance.status_mirror.d: Remove and reflect the first eligible harmful effect, then wait %s seconds before reflecting again.
Reflected effects are capped at %s seconds and level %s. Reflection requires a valid hostile source.
skill.essence_ascendance.pure_state.desc: Prevents harmful status effects while enabled. Choose this or Status Mirror.
skill.essence_ascendance.rising_recovery: Natural food and Nexus regeneration accelerate by up to %s× as health falls.
The benefit grows as you lose health. Potions and other external healing are unaffected.
skill.essence_ascendance.life_steal.desc: Confirmed direct weapon hits heal %s%% of damage, adding %s percentage points per consecutive same-target hit, up to %s hits.
Maximum healing: %s%% of damage. Changing target, a melee miss or %s seconds without a hit breaks the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.feast_reflex.de: Food and drink use takes %s%% of normal time. Automatically consumes useful safe hotbar meals without interrupting item use.

While injured, eat toward natural regeneration. Metabolic Conversion can continue through full hunger for health; Metabolic Mending can do the same while damaged gear remains. Otherwise healthy meals must waste less than half their nutrition.
skill.essence_ascendance.inner_sustenanc: Outside combat, restore %s hunger and %s saturation every %s seconds, after a %s-second combat recovery lock.
At full hunger and saturation, passive exertion costs stop, sleep is optional and phantoms ignore you. Deliberate resource costs still apply.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunger_ward.des: Redirect %s%% of incoming health damage into saturation and hunger.
Each food point absorbs %s damage. Saturation pays first; the unredirected and unpaid portions reach health.
Queue incoming health damage and pay it evenly over %s seconds instead of immediately.
Delays damage; does not reduce it. Payments cannot trigger defenses again. Unpaid damage survives reconnects and skill changes.
Take %s%% of incoming health damage after armor, resistance and absorption. Applies to every hit, not a maximum-health hit cap.
Temporarily lose maximum health equal to %s%% of the damage prevented. After %s seconds without combat, those hearts return empty.
skill.essence_ascendance.metabolic_conve: Each excess healing point restores %s food points; each nutrition point eaten at full hunger restores %s health.
Food-healing cannot convert back into food. Feast Reflex can keep eating at full hunger while you are injured.
skill.essence_ascendance.pain_purge.desc: Healing also removes %s%% of its amount from unpaid delayed damage, without reducing the normal healing.
Works with food regeneration, Nexus regeneration, Life Steal and healing effects, including at full health. Cannot remove more debt than remains or trigger another heal.
skill.essence_ascendance.adrenaline.desc: After a hit actually removes more than %s%% of your pre-hit maximum health, gain a %s-second surge. Absorption, prevented damage and maximum health loss do not count.
Surge: +%s%% movement speed, +%s%% attack speed and +%s%% knockback resistance. Covers melee, bow and caster; refreshes rather than stacks.
gui.essence_ascendance.nexus.skills.tool: Waiting for skill values from the server.
Planned skill — gameplay not implemented yet.
skill.essence_ascendance.soul_ward.descr: Kills grant ward health equal to %s%% of the victim's maximum health, up to %s%% of your current maximum health.
Ward hearts last %s seconds; kills refresh the duration even at the cap. Potion absorption stays separate.
skill.essence_ascendance.deep_ward.descr: Increase Soul Ward capacity by +%s%% and retain its hearts during combat instead of expiring.
After %s seconds without hostile combat or a kill, ward hearts decay; a full ward takes %s seconds to empty. Combat pauses decay.
skill.essence_ascendance.shattering_ward: Damage breaking the final Soul Ward heart knocks away up to %s visible enemies within %s blocks, with %s knockback strength.
Regenerate %s%% of your maximum health per second for %s seconds. Repeated breaks refresh rather than stack regeneration.
Requires surviving the hit. Ward expiry, decay and skill changes do not trigger it; potion hearts do not trigger it.
skill.essence_ascendance.terrain_freedom: Ignore terrain slowing and reduced jumps, cobweb and berry-bush drag, honey sliding, and freezing. Keep firm footing on powder snow, soul sand and mud.
Prevents cactus, berry-bush, magma-block and freezing contact damage. Does not prevent attacks, suffocation, falls, drowning, fire or lava.
skill.essence_ascendance.aquatic_body.de: Restore full normal underwater mining efficiency, including while swimming off the ground. See through water with normal scene fog.
Does not boost swimming speed; Swim Speed bonuses and equipment still apply normally. Air supply, drowning, Mining Fatigue and normal tool requirements are unchanged.
skill.essence_ascendance.water_walking.d: Sprint across exposed water and lava surfaces at their natural height. Hold Sneak or stop sprinting to enter the liquid normally.
Enter from shore or above. Does not lift you out of a liquid, place blocks or prevent falling damage. Disabled while riding or flying.
skill.essence_ascendance.lavaborn.descri: Swim through lava using your normal swimming speed and see through its surfaces from inside. While immersed, lava and ordinary fire contact cannot hurt you.
Lava cannot ignite you, so leaving it does not cause lingering lava burns. Unrelated fire is not extinguished; attacks and damage outside immersion remain normal.
Reduces falling and movement-impact damage by %s%%, including wall collisions and landing on pointed dripstone.
Fall Resistance from your bonuses and equipment also protects against movement impacts. Does not protect against attacks.
skill.essence_ascendance.charged_jump.de: Hold Jump on solid ground to charge over %s seconds, then release for up to %sx your normal upward jump launch.
Movement keys steer the leap. Releasing early gives a smaller jump; leaving the ground, opening a screen, or changing movement mode cancels the charge.
skill.essence_ascendance.double_jump.des: Release and tap Jump again in midair for one extra jump with %sx your normal upward launch. Movement keys choose its direction.
Landing on solid ground restores the extra jump. Holding Jump does not repeat it. Swimming, climbing, gliding, flight, riding, and teleports reset it.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_jump.des: Replaces Double Jump with one look-directed air launch, using %sx your normal jump impulse. Look upward to climb or forward to accelerate.
Looking downward brakes instead of diving: up to %s%% of existing falling velocity is removed when looking straight down. Reduced fall momentum lowers accumulated fall damage.
Release and tap Jump again to activate; landing restores the shared air jump. This replaces Double Jump, never adds another charge.
gui.essence_ascendance.grindstone.recycl: Recycle one equipment input into recoverable construction materials and stored enchantment XP.
skill.essence_ascendance.tool_instinct.d: Automatically uses the best carried Ascendance mining tool. Against lower-tier materials, the speed bonus can reach %s%%.
The chosen tool’s enchantments, durability and harvest ability apply normally.
skill.essence_ascendance.mining_momentum: Continuous mining builds to +%s%% mining speed over %s same-material breaks.
Changing material preserves %s%% of build rate; the rhythm breaks after %s seconds without a successful block break.
skill.essence_ascendance.natures_boon.de: Eligible dimension-normal stone has a %s%% chance to produce an additional ore drop.
Extra ores match the dimension and use your mining tool’s usual loot effects.
skill.essence_ascendance.ore_sight.descr: While holding a pickaxe, outlines nearby ore within %s blocks through ordinary terrain.
Highlights the most valuable nearby connected deposit.
Reveals unopened loot-table containers within %s blocks through ordinary terrain.
Only containers that still own their unopened normal loot table are revealed; opening one removes it from the survey.
skill.essence_ascendance.hunters_study.d: Repeated kills of the same creature build full study over %s kills.
At full study, that creature's ordinary normal loot averages up to +%s virtual Looting, stacking with normal and equipment Looting.
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_bloom.d: Each ordinary creature kill has a %s%% chance to bloom from the victim's normal experience value.
A bloom accrues %s Gathering Essence per normal XP point plus %s%% bonus experience; fractional rewards carry forward exactly.
skill.essence_ascendance.torchbearer.des: After mining, automatically places a supported light at your feet only when the current dimension's hostile-spawn lighting rules consider that position dark enough.
Checks the exact block at your feet, then preserves normal placement and consumption for vanilla torches, c:torches, and essence_ascendance:torchbearer_lights.
Within %s blocks, every %s seconds each growing crop has a %s%% chance to grow once more.
Walking and landing cannot trample farmland or turtle eggs.
skill.essence_ascendance.herdkeeper.desc: Nearby non-tamed breedable animals within %s blocks gather toward you, and positive breeding cooldown recovers at %sx normal speed.
Animal movement stays on normal navigation; babies and animals already ready to breed do not receive artificial age changes.
skill.essence_ascendance.animal_gift.des: Within %s blocks, every %s seconds each well-fed adult with a registered renewable product has a %s%% chance to provide one normal production event.
Product behavior comes from the shared renewable-product registry and normal animal mechanics; container-bound products use a matching empty container from your inventory.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishing_instinc: While fishing, normal bite countdowns advance at %sx speed and the live reel window lasts %sx as long.
Your catches gain an average of %s extra Luck, alongside Luck of the Sea.
skill.essence_ascendance.fishers_call.de: Successful normal catches build Shoal to %s stacks; the shared chain expires after %s seconds without another catch.

At full Shoal, normal bite countdowns advance at up to %sx speed and each successful catch has up to a %s%% chance to roll one additional loaded fishing-table reward. Missing a bite or reeling without one resets the chain.
skill.essence_ascendance.salvagers_craft: With the skill effective, the grindstone gains a recycle button that destroys one equipment input and recovers materials from its loaded construction recipe at %s%% recovery.
A valid recycle always returns at least one resolved material; non-curse enchantments also return up to %s%% stored enchantment experience. Normal grindstone pickup remains vanilla.
skill.essence_ascendance.pocket_nets.des: While in water, every %s seconds Pocket Nets makes one %s%% catch roll.
Successful catches use your Luck. Rewards enter your inventory or drop nearby if it is full.
skill.essence_ascendance.threat_sense.de: Within %s blocks, brackets creatures actively targeting you, traces dangerous projectile flight, and shows primed explosion danger radii.
Projectile previews show observed flight from launch and extend forward using live velocity, normal gravity, and block collisions.
Threat Sense creature tracking persists for %s seconds after a threat stops actively targeting you.
Tracked threats display a compact health bar and armor pips above them.
skill.essence_ascendance.waylight.descri: An ethereal companion grants clear night vision, negates Blindness and Darkness, and searches within %s blocks for nearby natural hostile-mob spawn footing.
The wisp organically travels to the nearest valid footing and marks only spawnable ground; it does not place light blocks.
tooltip.essence_ascendance.masterwork.in: Stored reinforcement inactive until Masterwork Tempering is selected
tooltip.essence_ascendance.masterwork.bu: Durability buffer only for this item type
skill.essence_ascendance.essence_wings.d: Hold Jump at or after an airborne apex to deploy an equipment-free Elytra-style glide with %s horizontal drag compensation.
Steer with your look direction. Landing ends the glide.
Hold Jump while airborne for up to %s s of jetpack thrust at %sx live gravity acceleration.

Thrust adds to your current vertical velocity instead of cancelling a fall first; movement controls steer using your resolved Flight Speed. Release Jump to fall normally; empty stamina takes %s s to refill while grounded.
skill.essence_ascendance.vector_boost.de: Tap Jump during an Essence Wings glide to reach a %sx multiplier of normal firework cruise speed along your look direction.
The burst recharges in %s seconds. Works with any jump style, including ordinary jumps; only an active Essence Wings glide is required.
skill.essence_ascendance.untethered_flig: Hold Jump while airborne to enter sustained free flight. Flight Speed bonuses apply; landing ends the flight.
Fly freely without a stamina limit.
Reduces fall damage by %s%%. With Impact Control, it also reduces damage from wall collisions and pointed dripstone.
stat.essence_ascendance.damage_reflectio: Increases damage reflected by a shield by %s%%.
stat.essence_ascendance.max_health.descr: Adds %s hearts to your maximum health.
stat.essence_ascendance.healing_effectiv: Increases eligible healing by %s%%. Food and Nexus regeneration are unaffected.
stat.essence_ascendance.hunger_efficienc: Reduces exhaustion from ordinary activity by %s%%. Deliberate hunger costs are unchanged.
stat.essence_ascendance.breath_hold.desc: Adds %s seconds of underwater breathing time.
stat.essence_ascendance.step_height.desc: Increases the height you can step over by %s blocks.
stat.essence_ascendance.flight_speed.des: Increases flight speed by %s%% while using a supported flight ability.
stat.essence_ascendance.fortune.descript: Adds %s levels of Fortune to eligible mining drops.
stat.essence_ascendance.looting.descript: Adds %s levels of Looting to eligible creature drops.
stat.essence_ascendance.luck.description: Adds %s luck to loot rolls that use luck.
stat.essence_ascendance.sneak_speed.desc: Increases movement speed while sneaking by %s%%.
stat.essence_ascendance.durability_effic: Reduces durability consumed by %s%%, including wear absorbed by Overdurability.
stat.essence_ascendance.reach.descriptio: Increases interaction and melee reach by %s blocks.
stat.essence_ascendance.anvil_efficiency: Reduces anvil experience and repair-material costs by %s%%.
stat.essence_ascendance.enchanting_effic: Reduces enchanting experience and lapis costs by %s%%.
Reduces the delay before your shield can block by %s%%.
stat.essence_ascendance.guarded_movement: Removes %s%% of the movement slowdown while guarding.

guide.essence_ascendance.archive.entry.g: Welcome to Ascendance
Start here after reaching Dormant.
The Archive is your guide and reference for Essence Ascendance. It remembers where you were in Guide, Reference, and Search for the current connection.
Collect Latent materials and learn how Essence is produced.
Build machines to store, route, and infuse Essence.
Use the Ascendance Nexus to manage progression, Bonuses, and Skills.
Right-click the Ascendance Archive whenever you want to return. No nearby machine is required.
The Archive is a portable interface, not a placeable machine.
Collecting Essence
Find Latent material and begin producing Essence.
Latent resources begin the material path. Machine processing and configured item mappings determine what can become Essence in the current pack.
Latent Ore is one recognizable starting material.
Pack data is authoritative. The Archive does not invent yields that are absent from the installed configuration.
Your First Machine Network
Meet the machines that move progression forward.
The Crucible processes mapped materials. Pylons and Foci contribute machine support, the Infuser performs infusion work, and the Nexus hosts Ascendance decisions.
The Essence Crucible uses its real registered item presentation.
Archive illustrations are explanatory figures. They never instantiate a working block entity, menu, or world simulation.
Beginning Infusion
Prepare an Infuser and an Essence Focus.
The Infuser combines a workpiece with its required inputs. Its current interface identifies the active workpiece mode, valid sources, and processing state.
The Essence Infuser renders from the same asset used by its item.
The Focus figure uses the same mesh and tier-aware item presentation as the real Focus.
Follow the live Infuser interface for authoritative requirements and progress.
Using the Nexus
Review Attunement and commit progression choices.
The Ascendance Nexus separates staged choices from committed progression. Review pending Bonus and Skill changes before applying them.
The Nexus remains the authoritative progression interface.
Closing with pending changes follows the Nexus confirmation flow; the Archive never submits those changes.
Choosing Skills
Read prerequisites and choice relationships first.
Skills belong to Essence paths and may have tier gates, prerequisite ranks, choice groups, or replacement relationships.
Tier gate
Shown by the Nexus
Prerequisites
Evaluated per rank
Choice and replacement decisions can change which Skills are active. Use the Nexus preview before committing.
guide.essence_ascendance.archive.entry.r: Plan, review, and apply Bonus and Skill changes.
The client presents synchronized state and may preview choices. The server validates and commits gameplay changes.
Apply the complete plan when you have enough Essence and meet its requirements. If a requirement is not met, none of the plan is applied.
Changing a slider or a Skill choice previews the result. Closing without applying leaves your existing choices unchanged.

guide.essence_ascendance.archive.referen: Choose one or more Essence categories to find items that provide them when dissolved in a Crucible. Every amount is for one individual item.
Per individual item · exact Essence from Crucible dissolution
Item yields are not available until the current world finishes providing them.
Filled Essentium depends on its stored contents; see extraction below.
Filled Essentium returns Essence according to its stored contents and the current extraction efficiency, so it does not have one fixed row here.
Dissolves valid inputs into the owner's capped per-Essence reservoir and channels it to available Essence.
Contributes Focus-dependent capacity, range, transfer, dissolution speed, and parallel processing to a linked Crucible.
Consumes linked reservoir Essence for carrier conversion, Focus upgrades, equipment infusion, and artifact repair.
Server-authoritative home for allocation, Skills, tier advancement, and Category Attunement presentation.
Construction component for the Crucible, Pylon, Infuser, and Nexus; it has no ticking machine state.
Installable evolving item: Latent enables baseline Pylon and Infuser operation; completed tiers add upgrades.
Your reservoir survives breaking or replacing a Crucible.
%s dissolves enabled inputs and channels its owner's stored Essence.

Active linked Pylons add their bonuses together. Dissolution time = base time ÷ (1 + total speed bonus), rounded up to the next tick (minimum 1 tick; 20 ticks = 1 second). Each active Pylon also adds an input slot, up to the slot limit.
The first permitted player binds an unowned Crucible. The reservoir is player-owned, shared across that owner's Crucibles, and survives breaking or replacing a block.
An item must have an Essence yield to be dissolved. Enable the Essence types you want to collect and leave room in their reservoirs. Your dissolution mode controls which items are accepted.
Item pipes and hoppers require an available automation port. They must still use valid inputs and cannot exceed the machine's input capacity.
Check for an item with no yield, disabled Essence types, a full reservoir, or an unclaimed Crucible. To receive channeled Essence, stay within transfer range.
Install a Focus and link the Pylon to a Crucible with the same owner.
%s extends one linked Crucible through its installed Focus.
Place the Pylon within the link radius of a Crucible, claim both with the same player, and install a Focus. Link distance is measured in all directions, including vertically.
Only linked Pylons belonging to the Crucible's owner can help it. The closest qualifying Pylons are used first, up to the active limit.
Install or remove the Focus by hand through the Pylon menu. Hoppers and item pipes cannot access this slot.
An empty Focus slot leaves the Pylon inactive. A Latent Focus enables basic operation; upgrading it adds the bonuses listed above.
The Infuser draws Essence from its owner's linked Crucible reservoir.
Use %s to fill Essentium, upgrade Focuses and equipment, or repair Ascendance artifacts.

For timed work, duration = required work ÷ Focus throughput, rounded up to the next tick (20 ticks = 1 second). Focus and equipment upgrades instead accumulate Essence on the item; removing the workpiece does not erase that progress.

Latent Nugget, Ingot, and Block workpieces produce full Essentium carriers of the selected target Essence. Capacity is 1/9, 1, or 9 times the listed ingot capacity. Source cost accounts for Focus efficiency and, when source and target differ, conversion efficiency; extraction applies its own efficiency once.
Fill or convert Essentium, upgrade an Essence Focus, raise equipment by one tier, or fully repair a damaged Ascendance artifact.
Install a Focus, insert a suitable workpiece, supply its required materials, and make sure the linked reservoir contains the Essence it needs.
Item pipes and hoppers can move only inputs permitted for the selected operation. Insert Focus upgrades, equipment upgrades, and repair workpieces by hand.

Check the installed Focus and its tier, the same-owner Crucible link, required materials, reservoir balance, and output space. An incompatible workpiece or damaged upgrade progress also prevents work.
Upgrade the same Focus as your machines grow.
Install %s in a Pylon or Infuser to enable it. A Latent Focus works without an upgrade; each higher tier improves the values shown below.
Manage Bonuses, Skills, and Ascension at the Nexus.
%s lets you spend or reassign Essence, choose Skills, and advance after earning enough Attunement seals. It needs no fuel.
Open the Nexus and wait for your balances to load before making changes.
Adjust your Bonus investments and Skill choices, review the cost or refund, then apply the changes. Check Category Attunement to see which seals you still need for Ascension.

Previewing changes spends nothing. Applying a plan requires enough Essence and must satisfy the listed caps, Skill prerequisites, and choice restrictions. Ascension requires the current chapter's seals.
A building material for Ascendance machines.
Craft Channelstone, then use it in recipes for Ascendance machines.
Channelstone itself is a construction material, not a machine or an Essence container.
Placing Channelstone beside a machine does not extend its range or create a link.
Partial upgrade progress stays on the equipment.
Upgrade Ascendance equipment one tier at a time in an Infuser. Each row gives the Essence and Matrix cost for reaching that tier; the weights below determine the share of each Essence needed.
Use Ascendance armor, weapons, tools, or a shield that has not yet reached Transcendent. Ordinary equipment cannot receive these tier upgrades. Supply the materials required for the next tier.
Essence is added gradually, and the workpiece keeps its progress if removed. Insert the equipment by hand; automated input is not supported for upgrades.
The first Essence invested in an artifact binds it to you. Fresh Latent equipment with no investment is not yet Soulbound. Later upgrades preserve the binding.
Ascendance artifacts persist through durability exhaustion and can be restored in the Infuser.
Ascendance artifacts become Fractured when their durability is exhausted. They remain recoverable and can be restored in an Infuser.
A hit that would break the artifact instead leaves it Fractured. It is not destroyed and takes no further wear until repaired.
Infuser Repair fully restores one damaged artifact. Cost = missing durability × Essence per durability. A Fractured artifact pays for its full durability and also requires the listed Latent Ingots.
Fractured armor, weapons, and tools lose their upgraded physical stats and perform at Latent strength. A Fractured shield stops functioning entirely until repaired.
Your Soulbound connection survives upgrades, repairs, enchantments, and renaming.

A Soulbound artifact returns to its bound owner after death, even if someone else was carrying it. Recovery tries its original slot, then an empty inventory slot. If there is no room, it waits for space instead of dropping the item.

Ordinary enchantments still apply. Essence Fortune and Looting add to the item's real enchantment levels, up to their effective limits. These extra levels do not add an enchantment glint or appear as enchantments on the item.

Fractured artifacts need Infuser Repair, not ordinary maintenance. Masterwork Tempering adds a protective durability buffer to a fully repaired, eligible item using a compatible repair material; it does not repair existing damage.
You can plan Bonus and Skill changes at the Nexus without spending Essence immediately. Check the complete plan before applying it.
Dissolving items fills your Crucible reservoir. Channel that Essence to make it available, then spend it on Bonuses and Skills at the Nexus.
Your Crucibles share one reservoir, with a separate capacity for each Essence. Stored Essence must be channeled to you before you can spend it at the Nexus.
Available Essence is your unspent balance for each category. Channeling transfers Essence from the reservoir into this balance.
Invested Essence funds your Bonuses. Skill purchases also remember what you paid, so a refund returns the original amount and Essence type.
When you apply a Nexus plan, all Bonus and Skill purchases and refunds are handled together. An invalid plan spends nothing.

Earn category seals through real gameplay, then ascend at the Nexus once you have enough seals for your current chapter. You can mix activities within a category. Investing Essence can speed up progress, but investment totals and world milestones are not Ascension requirements. Each new tier starts a new chapter; respeccing does not erase earned progress.

The tables show base progress as a percentage of one seal per unit, before investment, repetition, and variety. Investment multiplier = 1 + acceleration × square root of (category investment ÷ the listed reference), capped at the maximum above. Reusing a source becomes slower but still counts; mixing sources improves efficiency.
Durability Efficiency reduces wear. Repair restores missing durability; reinforcement adds a separate protective buffer.
Normal equipment still uses its usual repair materials and repair methods. A maintenance Skill helps only items that meet that Skill's requirements.
Ascendance artifacts Fracture instead of disappearing when their durability runs out. Restore them with Infuser Repair; normal maintenance cannot mend a Fractured artifact.
Overdurability absorbs wear before the item's normal durability. If its allowed capacity falls, excess buffer is lost. Raising the capacity again does not refill it for free.
Death does not erase your Essence progression. Soulbound artifacts also have special recovery.
You keep available Essence, Bonus investments, purchased Skills, your tier, and earned Attunement through death.
A Soulbound artifact returns to its bound owner after its carrier dies, even when the carrier was another player.
Recovery tries the original slot, then a free inventory slot. If your inventory is full, make room; the artifact remains pending rather than being dropped.
If a Bonus cap is lowered, Essence you already invested is preserved. Only the portion within the new cap provides a benefit.
You keep the full amount invested, even above the current cap.
The Bonus uses whichever is smaller: your investment or the current cap. No further capacity remains while your investment is at or above that cap.
You can leave an over-cap investment alone or reduce it. To increase it again, your new amount must be within the current cap.
These are the item's base stats, before your Bonuses, Skills, or enchantments. Damage uses health points: 2 points = 1 heart.
Worn Bonus shares add across your equipped armor. Latent armor grants no Essence Bonuses. Each upgraded piece applies its own Durability Efficiency at full strength, not at its worn share.

Select a Bonus below for its effects and costs. Latent equipment cannot channel Bonuses. Upgraded equipment channels them up to the lower of your tier and the item's tier; its base physical stats still belong to the item.
Rates are actions per second before Bonuses and Skills. Bow draw time and caster cooldown are 20 ÷ rate ticks, rounded to the nearest whole tick (minimum 1).
Mining speed applies to blocks this tool is suited to. Harvest level determines which mining requirements it can meet; the block must still permit that tool.

While holding a functional shield, passive reflection returns a percentage of the health damage you actually take. Your shield's base reflection is added to the stronger of your shield and worn-armor Damage Reflection Bonuses; those two Bonuses do not add together. Two held shields do not stack.

A successful block reflects a percentage of the damage that was blocked. Reflection = (base shield reflection + shield Damage Reflection Bonus) × block amplifier. The table's block reflection assumes no invested Bonus. The amplifier does not multiply passive reflection from damage you take.

Guard Readiness reduces raising delay and disable time. Guarded Movement improves movement while using the shield; guarding Knockback Resistance applies during a valid block. A Fractured shield cannot guard or reflect.
Complete any %s of the %s category seals to advance. The investment values below are only the amounts that reach maximum acceleration; they are not required spending.
